purpose: Content-bind the sole pure-append path beyond its frozen prefix. The P2 pin in src/verify_retained_integrity.py proves only the frozen prefix byte-exact and accepts any bytes behind it, so before this ledger a same-length in-place rewrite of the lawfully-appended region would have passed every mechanical check. This sidecar records a monotone snapshot history that closes that hole.
rule: Every recorded snapshot must remain a byte-exact prefix of the current file forever; snapshots must grow strictly monotonically in bytes; the newest snapshot must equal the current file exactly. Any alteration (same-length or not), truncation, stale/bogus historical snapshot, malformed or non-monotone ledger, or lawful append not registered here within the appending unit's own commit FAILS loudly. Lawful appends add exactly one snapshot in the appending unit's commit.
status: non-retained, unpinned, version-controlled documentation-sidecar; never a substitute for the immutable freeze manifests
